study: Independent family support for shared receiver induced position shifts
case_selection: Post-hoc opposing position effects in the previous 24-case development study, not a fresh accuracy cohort
models: previously RF-qualified shared RX1 RF-scaled 50 Hz coefficient model
heldout_design: Three seeded random whole-family folds; all curved and predictive owners across receivers and channels assigned together
train_fits: Both models and c arms use cold regional center, five phase rounds and 48 steps; held families contribute neither calibration nor position observations
heldout_primary: Normalized Gaussian moment predictive reference, using original per-ID sigma times sqrt(2), full train-only nuisance covariance and untouched held phase/orbit/fragment priors
heldout_noise_sensitivity: Original per-ID sigma factors 1 and 2; no model selected from this sensitivity
heldout_position_comparison: Same predictor evaluated at both train-only baseline and receiver-model endpoints, with train-only nuisance refresh at each; no additional position optimization
score_limits: Conditional on inherited all-RF graph, assignments, support and noise map
Conditional on a trained point position; training position uncertainty not integrated
Gaussian moment matching for held Student phase and Gamma noise, not the exact original heavy-tailed predictive density
Held phase linearization uses causal prior means, never held fitted phase
All folds and failures retained; no rejection by geographic error
geometry_design: Both models at 11 common locations along each full-data baseline-to-receiver endpoint segment, five fixed-position phase refreshes, full objective decomposition and local nuisance information diagnostics
geometry_limits: Full-data conditional mechanism test; neither independent family validation nor proof of incorrect satellite identity
interpretation: No GPS-based model/gate/scale/assignment selection; geographic truth only for final descriptive reporting
publication: Complete MD report, figures, sources, negative results and audits to remote main after checks
